questions.question: FastAPI tự động tạo documentation từ đâu?

options.B: Từ Python type hints và Pydantic models — tự động generate OpenAPI schema, Swagger UI (/docs), ReDoc (/redoc)

questions.explanation: FastAPI dùng Python type hints để: (1) Validate request data. (2) Serialize response data. (3) Generate OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation tự động. Pydantic BaseModel: class UserCreate(BaseModel): name: str; email: EmailStr; age: int = Field(ge=18). Route: @app.post('/users', response_model=UserResponse). FastAPI tự generate /docs (Swagger UI) và /redoc endpoints. Zero config cần thiết.

questions.question: Pydantic models trong FastAPI dùng để làm gì?

options.A: Pydantic chỉ dùng để serialize JSON
options.B: Pydantic: data validation, parsing, serialization với type annotations; BaseModel tự validate fields, raise ValidationError nếu data không hợp lệ; response_model để shape response

questions.explanation: class Item(BaseModel): name: str; price: float = Field(gt=0); tags: list[str] = []; created_at: datetime = None. FastAPI auto-parse request body → Item instance. Validation: type check, Field constraints (gt, ge, le, max_length, regex). Nested models: class Order(BaseModel): items: list[Item]. response_model=Item → shape response, strip sensitive fields. Config: model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True) để parse SQLAlchemy objects. Pydantic v2: 5-50x faster than v1.

questions.question: FastAPI path parameters, query parameters, và request body — cách khai báo?

options.A: Tất cả đều khai báo như nhau
options.B: Path: /items/{item_id} → param trong function. Query: default value hoặc Optional → auto query param. Body: Pydantic model type → auto body parse
options.C: Phải dùng request.json() để parse body

questions.explanation: @app.get('/items/{item_id}') async def get_item(item_id: int, # path param q: str | None = None, # query param (optional) skip: int = 0, # query param (default) limit: int = Query(default=10, le=100)): # query with validation. @app.post('/items/') async def create_item(item: Item, # body (Pydantic model) background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, # dependency q: Optional[str] = None): # both body + query. Mix: item_id path + item body + q query → tất cả cùng trong 1 function.

questions.question: FastAPI Dependency Injection dùng thế nào?

options.B: Depends() decorator tự inject dependencies — database sessions, auth verification, shared logic; dependencies có thể nest và có thể yield (context manager)

questions.explanation: async def get_db(): db = SessionLocal(); try: yield db; finally: db.close(). def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme), db: Session = Depends(get_db)): user = verify_token(token, db); if not user: raise HTTPException(401). @app.get('/me') async def get_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)). Nested: get_current_user depends on get_db + oauth2_scheme. Caching: Depends(get_db, use_cache=True) — same db per request. Class-based: class Pagination: def __init__(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 10): ...

questions.question: FastAPI async vs sync route handlers — khi nào dùng gì?

options.A: Luôn dùng sync cho đơn giản
options.B: async def: cho I/O-bound (database, HTTP calls) dùng await. def: cho CPU-bound hoặc blocking sync libraries — FastAPI run trong threadpool. Không mix blocking calls trong async handlers
options.C: async và sync hoàn toàn giống nhau trong FastAPI

questions.explanation: FastAPI dùng Starlette + asyncio. async def handler: chạy trên event loop — phải dùng await cho tất cả I/O (async SQLAlchemy, httpx, aiofiles). def handler: FastAPI chạy trong threadpool (concurrent.futures) để không block event loop — dùng cho sync libraries như requests, psycopg2. Problem: async def handler + sync blocking call (time.sleep(), requests.get()) → block event loop → tất cả requests bị delay. Fix: asyncio.to_thread() hoặc run_in_executor() cho blocking calls trong async handlers.

questions.question: FastAPI middleware và CORS setup?

options.B: @app.middleware('http') hoặc app.add_middleware(). CORS: CORSMiddleware với allow_origins list; GZipMiddleware, HTTPSRedirectMiddleware built-in

questions.explanation: CORS: app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=['https://app.com', 'http://localhost:3000'], allow_credentials=True, allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*']). Custom middleware: @app.middleware('http') async def add_process_time_header(request: Request, call_next): start = time.time(); response = await call_next(request); response.headers['X-Process-Time'] = str(time.time() - start); return response. Starlette middleware: BaseHTTPMiddleware. Other built-ins: GZipMiddleware, TrustedHostMiddleware, HTTPSRedirectMiddleware.

questions.question: FastAPI với SQLAlchemy async — setup đúng cách?

options.B: sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio với AsyncEngine, AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker; create_async_engine với async DB URL; yield session trong Depends
options.C: Chỉ dùng sync SQLAlchemy trong FastAPI
options.D: Async SQLAlchemy không cần connection pool

questions.explanation: engine = create_async_engine('postgresql+asyncpg://user:pass@host/db', pool_size=20, max_overflow=10). async_session = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False). async def get_db() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]: async with async_session() as session: yield session. Model: class User(Base): __tablename__ = 'users'; id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True). Query: result = await session.execute(select(User).where(User.id == user_id)); user = result.scalar_one_or_none(). Alembic cho migrations với async support.

questions.question: FastAPI background tasks và Celery — khi nào dùng gì?

options.B: BackgroundTasks: simple tasks sau response (send email); Celery: distributed, retry, scheduling, monitoring — dùng cho heavy/critical tasks

questions.explanation: BackgroundTasks: @app.post('/users/') async def create_user(user: UserCreate, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks): new_user = await create_user_in_db(user); background_tasks.add_task(send_welcome_email, new_user.email); return new_user. Nhược điểm: task bị lost nếu server restart, không retry, không monitoring. Celery: from celery import Celery; app = Celery('tasks', broker='redis://localhost:6379'); @app.task def send_email(to: str): ... Task queue persist in Redis/RabbitMQ, retry on failure, scheduled tasks (celery beat), monitoring (Flower). Dùng Celery cho: payment processing, heavy computation, scheduled jobs.

questions.question: FastAPI authentication — OAuth2 with JWT implementation?

options.B: OAuth2PasswordBearer scheme, JWT với python-jose, /token endpoint, Depends(get_current_user) bảo vệ routes, refresh tokens

questions.explanation: oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl='token'). @app.post('/token') async def login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends()): user = authenticate_user(form_data.username, form_data.password); if not user: raise HTTPException(401); access_token = create_access_token({'sub': user.username}, expires_delta=timedelta(minutes=15)); return {'access_token': access_token, 'token_type': 'bearer'}. async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)): payload = jwt.decode(token, SECRET, algorithms=['HS256']); user = await get_user(payload['sub']); return user. @app.get('/me') async def me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)).

questions.question: FastAPI testing với pytest và httpx?

options.B: TestClient(app) từ starlette, hoặc AsyncClient(app) cho async tests; pytest fixtures cho db setup; override_dependency để mock
options.D: FastAPI tests phải run server riêng

questions.explanation: Sync test: from fastapi.testclient import TestClient; client = TestClient(app); def test_create_user(): response = client.post('/users/', json={'name': 'Test', 'email': 'test@test.com'}); assert response.status_code == 201; assert response.json()['name'] == 'Test'. Async test: @pytest.mark.anyio async def test_async(): async with AsyncClient(app=app, base_url='http://test') as ac: response = await ac.get('/users/'). Override dependency: app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db. Fixtures: @pytest.fixture def test_db(): engine = create_engine(TEST_DB_URL); ...; yield db.

questions.question: FastAPI exception handling và custom exception handlers?

options.A: FastAPI chỉ trả về HTTP 500 khi có lỗi
options.B: HTTPException với status_code/detail; @app.exception_handler() cho custom exceptions và RequestValidationError; UnicornException pattern
options.C: Exceptions không thể customize trong FastAPI
options.D: Validation errors phải handle thủ công

questions.explanation: Built-in: raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='User not found', headers={'X-Error': 'custom'}). Custom exception: class UserNotFoundError(Exception): def __init__(self, user_id: int): self.user_id = user_id. @app.exception_handler(UserNotFoundError) async def user_not_found_handler(request, exc): return JSONResponse(status_code=404, content={'detail': f'User {exc.user_id} not found'}). Override validation errors: @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) async def validation_exception_handler(request, exc): return JSONResponse(status_code=422, content={'errors': exc.errors(), 'body': exc.body}). Global: app.add_exception_handler(Exception, general_exception_handler).

questions.question: FastAPI routers và application structure cho large projects?

options.A: Tất cả routes phải trong main.py
options.B: APIRouter() để group routes theo feature; prefix, tags, dependencies per router; include_router() trong main app; lifespan events

questions.explanation: router = APIRouter(prefix='/users', tags=['Users'], dependencies=[Depends(verify_api_key)], responses={404: {'description': 'Not found'}}). @router.get('/') async def get_users(): ... @router.post('/', status_code=201) async def create_user(): ... app.include_router(router). Structure: app/ main.py, api/ v1/ users.py products.py auth.py, models/, schemas/, services/, db/. Lifespan: @asynccontextmanager async def lifespan(app: FastAPI): await startup(); yield; await shutdown(); app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan). Deprecate old routes: @router.get('/old', deprecated=True).

questions.question: Implement FastAPI với Alembic migrations — workflow?

options.B: alembic init, env.py với SQLAlchemy models, alembic revision --autogenerate, alembic upgrade head trong startup hoặc CI
options.C: Alembic không compatible với async SQLAlchemy

questions.explanation: Setup: alembic init alembic. env.py: from app.models import Base; target_metadata = Base.metadata; config.set_main_option('sqlalchemy.url', DATABASE_URL). Create migration: alembic revision --autogenerate -m 'add users table'. Run: alembic upgrade head. Async setup: process_revision_directives trong env.py. Run on startup: @asynccontextmanager async def lifespan(app): async with engine.begin() as conn: await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all); yield. CI/CD: alembic upgrade head trước khi start app. Rollback: alembic downgrade -1.

questions.question: FastAPI với Redis caching — implement cache decorator?

options.B: aioredis client, Depends(get_redis), cache trong route handler; custom @cache decorator với key generation và TTL; invalidate on write
options.C: Chỉ HTTP cache headers là đủ

questions.explanation: redis = aioredis.from_url('redis://localhost'). async def get_redis(): yield redis. Route: @app.get('/products/{id}') async def get_product(id: int, r: Redis = Depends(get_redis)): cached = await r.get(f'product:{id}'); if cached: return json.loads(cached); product = await product_service.get(id); if not product: raise HTTPException(404); await r.setex(f'product:{id}', 3600, json.dumps(product.dict())); return product. Decorator: def cache(ttl=60, prefix=''): def decorator(func): @wraps(func) async def wrapper(*args, **kwargs): key = f'{prefix}:{hash(str(args)+str(kwargs))}'; ... Cache invalidation on write: await r.delete(f'product:{id}').

questions.question: FastAPI file upload và streaming responses?

options.B: UploadFile type cho file uploads; StreamingResponse cho large files; BackgroundTasks để process sau upload; validation của file type/size
options.C: Phải dùng Flask cho file handling

questions.explanation: Upload: @app.post('/upload') async def upload(file: UploadFile, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks): if file.content_type not in ['image/jpeg', 'image/png']: raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid file type'); content = await file.read(); if len(content) > 10 * 1024 * 1024: raise HTTPException(413, 'File too large'); await save_to_s3(content, file.filename); background_tasks.add_task(process_image, file.filename); return {'filename': file.filename}. Multiple: files: list[UploadFile]. Streaming: async def generate(): yield chunk1; yield chunk2; return StreamingResponse(generate(), media_type='text/csv', headers={'Content-Disposition': 'attachment; filename=data.csv'}).

questions.question: FastAPI WebSocket implementation?

options.B: @app.websocket() decorator, WebSocket object, accept/receive/send, ConnectionManager cho multiple clients, JWT auth cho WebSocket

questions.explanation: class ConnectionManager: def __init__(self): self.active_connections: dict[str, WebSocket] = {}; async def connect(self, ws, client_id): await ws.accept(); self.active_connections[client_id] = ws; async def broadcast(self, message): for ws in self.active_connections.values(): await ws.send_text(message). @app.websocket('/ws/{client_id}') async def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket, client_id: str, token: str = Query(...)): try: await manager.connect(websocket, client_id); while True: data = await websocket.receive_text(); await manager.broadcast(f'{client_id}: {data}'); except WebSocketDisconnect: manager.disconnect(client_id).

questions.question: FastAPI với Pydantic settings và environment management?

options.B: pydantic-settings BaseSettings: type-safe env vars, .env file loading, nested settings, @lru_cache singleton, validation

questions.explanation: from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict; class Settings(BaseSettings): model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_file='.env', env_file_encoding='utf-8'); DATABASE_URL: str; SECRET_KEY: str = Field(min_length=32); REDIS_URL: str = 'redis://localhost:6379'; ENVIRONMENT: Literal['development', 'staging', 'production'] = 'development'; DEBUG: bool = False; ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES: int = 15. @lru_cache def get_settings() -> Settings: return Settings(). Inject: @app.get('/info') async def info(settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings)). Nested: class DatabaseSettings(BaseSettings): HOST: str; PORT: int = 5432. Override in tests: app.dependency_overrides[get_settings] = lambda: Settings(DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///test.db').

questions.question: FastAPI rate limiting — implementation options?

options.B: slowapi library (Limiter), redis-based rate limiting trong middleware, hoặc Nginx upstream rate limiting

questions.explanation: slowapi: limiter = Limiter(key_func=get_remote_address); app.state.limiter = limiter; app.add_exception_handler(RateLimitExceeded, _rate_limit_exceeded_handler). @app.get('/items/') @limiter.limit('10/minute') async def get_items(request: Request): return {'items': []}. Custom Redis rate limiting: async def rate_limit(request: Request, r: Redis = Depends(get_redis)): key = f'rate_limit:{request.client.host}'; count = await r.incr(key); if count == 1: await r.expire(key, 60); if count > 100: raise HTTPException(429, 'Rate limit exceeded'). Per-user: use user ID as key instead of IP.

questions.question: FastAPI validation errors trả về complex nested structure — cách customize?

options.B: @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) để override default 422 response; format errors phù hợp với frontend; dùng PydanticCustomError cho custom messages

questions.explanation: @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) async def validation_exception_handler(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError): errors = []; for error in exc.errors(): field = ' → '.join(str(loc) for loc in error['loc'][1:]); errors.append({'field': field, 'message': error['msg'], 'type': error['type']}); return JSONResponse(status_code=422, content={'status': 'error', 'message': 'Validation failed', 'errors': errors}). Custom Pydantic validator: @field_validator('email') @classmethod def validate_email(cls, v): if not v.endswith('@company.com'): raise ValueError('Must use company email'); return v.lower(). Pydantic v2: model_validator(mode='after').

questions.question: FastAPI async SQLAlchemy session management — common pitfalls?

options.A: Async SQLAlchemy sessions không có issues
options.B: Lazy loading không hoạt động trong async (MissingGreenlet); session scope issues (session per request); N+1 queries; rollback khi exception
options.C: Dùng sync SQLAlchemy trong async routes
options.D: Session có thể share giữa requests

questions.explanation: Pitfalls: (1) Lazy loading: user.posts access sau khi session đóng → MissingGreenlet error. Fix: eager loading selectinload: await session.execute(select(User).options(selectinload(User.posts))). (2) Session per request qua Depends(get_db) là đúng — không dùng global session. (3) N+1 với ORM: loop mỗi user.posts → dùng selectinload/joinedload. (4) Không commit sau write: await session.commit(). (5) Transaction rollback: try/except trong route với await session.rollback(). (6) expire_on_commit=False trong async_sessionmaker để tránh reload sau commit.

questions.question: FastAPI app startup chậm — nguyên nhân phổ biến?

options.B: Heavy imports trong module level; database connection warmup; Alembic migrations tại startup; large Pydantic models compilation

questions.explanation: Slow startup causes: (1) Module-level heavy imports (tensorflow, large ML models) — lazy import inside route handlers. (2) DB connection warmup: create_async_engine với pool_pre_ping=True nhưng pool warm-up takes time. (3) Alembic upgrade head tại startup → chạy migrations → chậm. Fix: separate migration step trong CI/CD. (4) Large Pydantic models: model schema compilation. Fix: model_rebuild() separately. Profile: python -c 'import cProfile; cProfile.run("import app.main")'. Optimization: (1) Lazy lifespan setup. (2) gunicorn --preload tận dụng fork. (3) Separate migrations từ startup.

questions.question: FastAPI circular imports trong routers — cách fix?

options.A: Circular imports không xảy ra trong FastAPI
options.B: Tách models, schemas, crud thành separate files; sử dụng TYPE_CHECKING để postpone imports; restructure dependency graph

questions.explanation: Circular: users/router.py imports from products/router.py và ngược lại. Fix: (1) Tách models.py (SQLAlchemy), schemas.py (Pydantic), crud.py (database operations), router.py (routes) — mỗi layer chỉ import từ layer dưới. (2) TYPE_CHECKING: from __future__ import annotations; from typing import TYPE_CHECKING; if TYPE_CHECKING: from app.users.models import User. (3) Dependency injection để tránh import circular services. (4) Event-based communication thay direct import. Structure: app/ core/ db.py, config.py; users/ models.py, schemas.py, crud.py, router.py.

questions.question: FastAPI không trả về expected response format — debugging?

options.A: FastAPI luôn trả về đúng format
options.B: response_model filter fields; response_model_exclude_none; jsonable_encoder cho custom types; Pydantic model_config from_attributes

questions.explanation: Issues: (1) response_model=UserResponse nhưng trả về SQLAlchemy object → dùng UserResponse.model_validate(db_user) hoặc model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True). (2) None fields included: response_model_exclude_none=True. (3) Extra fields: response_model_exclude_unset=True. (4) Custom types (UUID, datetime) không JSON serializable → jsonable_encoder(). (5) Nested models: Pydantic v2 model_validate không tự convert nested. Debug: from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder; print(jsonable_encoder(response)). (6) Union types: response_model=Union[A, B] → Pydantic pick correct model.

questions.question: CORS preflight OPTIONS request bị block — FastAPI debugging?

options.B: CORSMiddleware phải được add trước tất cả routers; allow_origins phải match exactly; credentials:true cần cụ thể origins không phải wildcard
options.D: CORS là browser issue không phải server

questions.explanation: CORS debugging: (1) CORSMiddleware order: phải app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, ...) TRƯỚC tất cả include_router(). Middleware được executed từ dưới lên (bottom-up). (2) allow_origins=['*'] không work với credentials=True → phải list specific origins. (3) allow_origins phải match EXACTLY (kể cả protocol và port): 'http://localhost:3000' không match 'https://localhost:3000'. (4) allow_methods: include 'OPTIONS' explicitly nếu custom allow_methods. (5) allow_headers phải include custom headers client gửi. Debug: curl -X OPTIONS -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' http://api/endpoint -v → check response headers.

questions.question: FastAPI production deployment với Docker và multiple workers?

options.A: FastAPI chỉ chạy trong development mode
options.B: Gunicorn với UvicornWorker cho multiple workers; Docker multi-stage build; health checks; graceful shutdown; Kubernetes với HPA

questions.explanation: Production: gunicorn app.main:app --workers 4 --worker-class uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 --timeout 30 --graceful-timeout 30. Dockerfile: FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder; COPY requirements.txt .; RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt; FROM python:3.12-slim; RUN adduser --disabled-password app; USER app; COPY --from=builder /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages /usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages; COPY . .; HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1; CMD gunicorn app.main:app -w 4 -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker. K8s: Deployment với resources limits, HPA (CPU + memory), liveness/readiness probes.

questions.question: FastAPI high-performance với async và connection pooling — architecture?

options.B: asyncpg cho PostgreSQL (fastest), SQLAlchemy async với pool settings, Redis connection pool, HTTP client pooling (httpx), avoid sync I/O trong async routes
options.C: Sync database là nhanh hơn async

questions.explanation: High-performance stack: (1) Database: asyncpg (raw) hoặc SQLAlchemy async với asyncpg dialect. pool_size=20, max_overflow=10, pool_timeout=30, pool_recycle=1800. (2) Redis: aioredis với connection pool: from_url('redis://localhost', max_connections=20). (3) HTTP client: httpx.AsyncClient với connection pooling — reuse trong lifespan. (4) Avoid blocking: không dùng requests.get() trong async routes → asyncio.to_thread() hoặc httpx. (5) Uvloop: uvicorn --loop uvloop → 2-4x faster event loop. (6) Profiling: py-spy, yappi. Benchmark: wrk, locust.

questions.question: FastAPI microservices communication — sync HTTP vs async messaging?

options.B: httpx cho sync service-to-service calls; RabbitMQ/Kafka cho async events; gRPC cho high-performance; service discovery với Consul/K8s
options.C: FastAPI không phù hợp cho microservices
options.D: Tất cả microservices phải dùng cùng database

questions.explanation: Service-to-service: (1) httpx async: async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client: response = await client.get(f'{USER_SERVICE_URL}/users/{user_id}'). Retry với tenacity: @retry(wait=wait_exponential(multiplier=1, min=4, max=10), stop=stop_after_attempt(3)). (2) Message queue (aio-pika cho RabbitMQ): publish events khi order created → inventory service consume. (3) gRPC: grpcio + protobuf — typed, binary, bidirectional streaming. (4) Circuit breaker: pybreaker để fail fast khi service down. (5) Service discovery: K8s Service DNS. (6) Distributed tracing: OpenTelemetry + Jaeger để trace across services.

questions.question: FastAPI observability — logging, metrics, tracing setup?

options.B: structlog cho structured logging, Prometheus với prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, Sentry error tracking

questions.explanation: Full observability stack: (1) Structured logging: import structlog; logger = structlog.get_logger(); logger.info('user_created', user_id=user.id, email=user.email). JSON output → Elasticsearch/Loki. (2) Prometheus: from prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator import Instrumentator; Instrumentator().instrument(app).expose(app). Custom metrics: counter = Counter('orders_total', 'Total orders', ['status']); counter.labels(status='completed').inc(). (3) OpenTelemetry: from opentelemetry.instrumentation.fastapi import FastAPIInstrumentor; FastAPIInstrumentor.instrument_app(app, tracer_provider=provider). (4) Sentry: sentry_sdk.init(dsn=DSN, integrations=[StarletteIntegration()]).

questions.question: FastAPI với machine learning model serving — best practices?

options.A: FastAPI không phù hợp cho ML
options.B: Load model tại startup (lifespan), async inference với threadpool, model caching, batch predictions, Triton Inference Server cho heavy models
options.C: Dùng Flask cho ML serving thay FastAPI

questions.explanation: ML serving pattern: @asynccontextmanager async def lifespan(app: FastAPI): # Load model once at startup model = await asyncio.to_thread(load_model, 'model.pkl'); app.state.model = model; yield. Route: @app.post('/predict') async def predict(request: PredictRequest, model = Depends(get_model)): result = await asyncio.to_thread(model.predict, [request.features]); return {'prediction': result[0].tolist()}. asyncio.to_thread(): run sync model.predict() without blocking event loop. Batch: collect requests with asyncio.gather(). Triton: for GPU models → gRPC to Triton server. Ray Serve: distributed ML serving. Model versioning: load multiple versions, A/B test.

questions.question: FastAPI security — OWASP API Security Top 10 compliance?

options.B: Broken Object Level Auth prevention, rate limiting, input validation, parameterized queries, secrets management, dependency scanning, penetration testing
options.D: HTTPS là chính, còn lại không quan trọng

questions.explanation: OWASP API Security Top 10 compliance: (1) Broken Object Level Auth: verify ownership trước mỗi resource access — if order.user_id != current_user.id: raise HTTPException(403). (2) Broken Auth: JWT short expiry (15min), secure cookies, MFA. (3) Excessive Data Exposure: response_model strict, không return sensitive fields. (4) Rate Limiting: slowapi, differentiate per endpoint. (5) Function Level Auth: role checks. (6) Mass Assignment: whitelist input fields via Pydantic (không accept arbitrary fields). (7) SQL Injection: SQLAlchemy params (không raw string). (8) Security Misconfiguration: disable /docs in production (app = FastAPI(docs_url=None)). (9) Secrets: Vault, không .env in production.
